entries.name: META_APP_ID
entries.description: Meta app for Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp: the app the Page token and the webhooks belong to. The read-only connector doesn't send it.
howToGet: At developers.facebook.com, create a Business app and copy its App ID.

entries.name: META_APP_SECRET
entries.description: Secret for the Meta app. Meta signs every webhook delivery with it (X-Hub-Signature-256), and the connector checks each signature with it; it is never sent anywhere.
howToGet: In the Meta app, go to Settings > Basic and copy the App Secret.

entries.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: System-user token for the WhatsApp Business API. WhatsApp has no API that reads messages, so the read-only connector never sends it; it is kept for the replies declared behind the write gate, which stay turned down.
howToGet: In Meta Business Settings, create a system user, assign the WhatsApp app, and generate a permanent token.

entries.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
entries.description: The WhatsApp business phone number's id (not the number itself). Webhook deliveries for any other number are left out.
howToGet: In the Meta app, go to WhatsApp > API Setup and copy the Phone number ID.

entries.name: WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN
entries.description: The verify token Meta sends when the webhook URL is saved (hub.verify_token). The connector answers Meta's check with the challenge only when it matches.
howToGet: Generated automatically by npm run secrets:setup.
In the Meta app's webhook settings, paste it as the Verify token next to the callback URL, then subscribe the app to the messages field.

entries.name: META_PAGE_ID
entries.description: The Facebook Page whose Messenger and Instagram conversations are read, by its numeric id.
howToGet: On the Page, open About > Page transparency (or the Page's settings) and copy the Page ID.

entries.name: META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A Page access token for the Page in META_PAGE_ID, sent as a bearer token to list its conversations and read their messages. Meta has no read-only messaging permission: pages_messaging and instagram_manage_messages can also send messages, so the connector only ever sends GET requests. It goes only to graph.facebook.com.
howToGet: A person with the MESSAGING task on the Page makes the token in the Meta app.
For Messenger give it pages_manage_metadata, pages_read_engagement and pages_messaging; for Instagram add instagram_basic and instagram_manage_messages.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: META_INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the Instagram professional account linked to the Page, so the store's own messages can be told from the customer's. Needed while META_CHANNELS has instagram on.
howToGet: In the Meta app's Instagram settings (or Meta Business Suite), copy the id of the Instagram account linked to the Page.

entries.name: META_CHANNELS
entries.description: Which DM channels each sync reads: messenger, instagram, or both separated by a comma. Both when empty. WhatsApp arrives by webhook whatever this says.
howToGet: Leave empty to read both; set messenger alone when the Page has no Instagram account.
